notes: The workspace and the pod's disk were recreated before this round, so the rig I had built was gone. Two things a fresh workspace lacks that the browser harness needs, and that cost me a wrong result before I found them: packages/contracts has no dist, which node's default export condition resolves to (bun run build there), and packages/dispatch/web/dist is absent (bun run build:web). Without them every page test fails with 'element(s) not found' - the harness serving nothing, not the change. My drivers I restored from the artifact I attached before the drain, dispatch://INFRA-715/artifact/infra715-tester-rig-tgz, which is why this round cost minutes rather than an hour; the Postgres on 127.0.0.1:55432 in this pod is another role's and I only added databases of my own to it.
risks: The 200-upload room test stays noisy: 673 to 2,979 B per upload across ten runs of this change, 1,361 B here. The bound holds with at least 2.8x margin in every run and the main-side control is 489,536 B per upload. Already on the PR body's Not proven line.
The place counting is quadratic in the number of refused places, about a second at 65,536 refused code blocks by the review's measurement. On the error path only; I did not re-measure it.
